column2: This flight is SYNTHETIC — numbers Debrief made up to demonstrate what it can read. It is not a recording of anything, nothing here was flown, and no figure from it means anything about a real rocket.
A tracker whose fix kept changing

The column names below are the ones a Featherweight GPS tracker writes, so that Debrief reads this file without being told about it. No tracker recorded anything here and no receiver of any kind did: see the Synthetic row above.
